overview: This enum names the follow-up attack a combo can accept or use automatically.

None.technical: The constructor sets both auto fields to this value. AddRequest removes it from the AttackTransitionKind list before the membership check. The action index map has no entry for it.

NormalAttack_1.simple: The first normal attack can be used as the next move.
NormalAttack_1.technical: It shares index 1 with NormalAttack_1 and NormalAttackAir_1 in GAttackActionIndexMap. AddRequest checks the requested action byte against the copied kind list. ResolveFollowUpAttackType can map this byte back to either action.

NormalAttack_1_Auto.simple: The automatic form of the first normal attack can be used as the next move.
NormalAttack_1_Auto.technical: It shares index 2 with NormalAttack_1_Auto and NormalAttackAir_1_Auto in GAttackActionIndexMap. ResolveFollowUpAttackType looks up either action from this byte when an auto field holds it.

NormalAttack_1_1.simple: The paired next hit after the first normal attack can be used as the next move.
NormalAttack_1_1.technical: GNormalAttackComboMap maps NormalAttack_1 and NormalAttackAir_1 to this action family. GAttackActionIndexMap gives it index 3 and gives its air counterpart the same index.

NormalAttack_1_1_Auto.simple: The automatic form of the paired next hit after the first normal attack can be used as the next move.
NormalAttack_1_1_Auto.technical: It shares index 4 with NormalAttack_1_1_Auto and NormalAttackAir_1_1_Auto in GAttackActionIndexMap. GNormalAttackToAirMap links those two actions.

NormalAttack_2.simple: The second normal attack can be used as the next move.
NormalAttack_2.technical: It shares index 5 with NormalAttack_2 and NormalAttackAir_2 in GAttackActionIndexMap. GNormalAttackComboMap pairs the base action with NormalAttack_2_1.

NormalAttack_2_Auto.simple: The automatic form of the second normal attack can be used as the next move.
NormalAttack_2_Auto.technical: It shares index 6 with NormalAttack_2_Auto and NormalAttackAir_2_Auto in GAttackActionIndexMap. ResolveFollowUpAttackType looks up either action from this byte when an auto field holds it.

NormalAttack_2_1.simple: The paired next hit after the second normal attack can be used as the next move.
NormalAttack_2_1.technical: GNormalAttackComboMap maps NormalAttack_2 and NormalAttackAir_2 to this action family. GAttackActionIndexMap gives it index 7 and gives its air counterpart the same index.

NormalAttack_2_1_Auto.simple: The automatic form of the paired next hit after the second normal attack can be used as the next move.
NormalAttack_2_1_Auto.technical: It shares index 8 with NormalAttack_2_1_Auto and NormalAttackAir_2_1_Auto in GAttackActionIndexMap. GNormalAttackToAirMap links those two actions.

NormalAttack_3.simple: The third normal attack can be used as the next move.
NormalAttack_3.technical: It shares index 9 with NormalAttack_3 and NormalAttackAir_3 in GAttackActionIndexMap. GNormalAttackComboMap pairs the base action with NormalAttack_3_1.

NormalAttack_3_Auto.simple: The automatic form of the third normal attack can be used as the next move.
NormalAttack_3_Auto.technical: It shares index 10 with NormalAttack_3_Auto and NormalAttackAir_3_Auto in GAttackActionIndexMap. ResolveFollowUpAttackType looks up either action from this byte when an auto field holds it.

NormalAttack_3_1.simple: The paired next hit after the third normal attack can be used as the next move.
NormalAttack_3_1.technical: GNormalAttackComboMap maps NormalAttack_3 and NormalAttackAir_3 to this action family. GAttackActionIndexMap gives it index 11 and gives its air counterpart the same index.

NormalAttack_3_1_Auto.simple: The automatic form of the paired next hit after the third normal attack can be used as the next move.
NormalAttack_3_1_Auto.technical: It shares index 12 with NormalAttack_3_1_Auto and NormalAttackAir_3_1_Auto in GAttackActionIndexMap. GNormalAttackToAirMap links those two actions.

CursedEnergyAttack_1.simple: The first Cursed Energy attack can be used as the next move.
CursedEnergyAttack_1.technical: It shares index 13 with CursedEnergyAttack_1 and CursedEnergyAttackAir_1 in GAttackActionIndexMap. A kind list containing this byte accepts either action as the requested follow-up.

CursedEnergyAttack_1_Auto.simple: The automatic form of the first Cursed Energy attack can be used as the next move.
CursedEnergyAttack_1_Auto.technical: It shares index 14 with CursedEnergyAttack_1_Auto and CursedEnergyAttackAir_1_Auto in GAttackActionIndexMap. It is a commonly authored value of AutoTransitionKind_CursedEnergy in the exported attack rows.

CursedEnergyAttack_2.simple: The second Cursed Energy attack can be used as the next move.
CursedEnergyAttack_2.technical: It shares index 15 with CursedEnergyAttack_2 and CursedEnergyAttackAir_2 in GAttackActionIndexMap. A kind list containing this byte accepts either action as the requested follow-up.

CursedEnergyAttack_2_Auto.simple: The automatic form of the second Cursed Energy attack can be used as the next move.
CursedEnergyAttack_2_Auto.technical: It shares index 16 with CursedEnergyAttack_2_Auto and CursedEnergyAttackAir_2_Auto in GAttackActionIndexMap. It is the other commonly authored value of AutoTransitionKind_CursedEnergy in the exported attack rows.

SuperCursedEnergyAttack.simple: The super Cursed Energy attack can be used as the next move.
SuperCursedEnergyAttack.technical: It shares index 17 with SuperCursedEnergyAttack and SuperCursedEnergyAttackAir in GAttackActionIndexMap. A kind list containing this byte accepts either action as the requested follow-up.

ExtraAttack_1.simple: The first extra attack can be used as the next move.
ExtraAttack_1.technical: It shares index 18 with ExtraAttack_1 in GAttackActionIndexMap. AddRequest removes other non-combo attack requests when this byte accepts the requested action.

ExtraAttack_2.simple: The second extra attack can be used as the next move.
ExtraAttack_2.technical: It shares index 19 with ExtraAttack_2 in GAttackActionIndexMap. AddRequest removes other non-combo attack requests when this byte accepts the requested action.

Invalid.simple: This value marks an invalid follow-up kind.
Invalid.technical: The enum declares it with value 255. The action index map has no entry for it, so a resolver finds no action from this byte. No traced consumer reads this member directly.

notes: The kind byte is a shared ordinal for the grounded and aerial versions of the same attack action.
AttackTransitionKind is a membership list. The runtime removes None, appends the current action byte, and accepts a request only when its mapped byte appears in that list.

AutoTransitionKind and AutoTransitionKind_CursedEnergy are single bytes. The resolver tries the Cursed Energy byte first, discards that result when Unknown149 is zero, and then tries the normal auto byte.
UCP_270_ActionController resolves only the Cursed Energy byte. UCP_260_ActionController blocks both auto resolutions while its support shield is active.
A member ending in Auto names an auto action and its air counterpart. A member ending in 1 names the alternate combo action paired with the base attack.
No traced consumer reads Invalid directly.
